The end-to-end online process for the State Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme commences with the applicant submitting the application online through the scholarship portal or via a Common Service Centre operator, as mandated under [GO-4.1] and [MIN-1], or alternatively through a mobile application as suggested in [VB-1]. The applicant must undergo mandatory Aadhaar-based e-KYC [GO-4.2] and provide caste and income certificates from DigiLocker or upload them in the prescribed format [GO-4.3]. Upon submission, the system automatically forwards the application to the institution [WF-T2]. The institution nodal officer is mandated to verify the application within 15 days [GO-5.1] and [MIN-4], after which the applicant is notified via SMS [GO-7.2]. If the application is rejected, the student must be informed of the reason by SMS and given one opportunity to correct it and re-apply [VB-3], [GO-5.3], and [WF-T4]. For renewal applications, previously verified documents must be reused without re-uploading [MIN-2].

Once the institution verifies the application, the District Social Welfare Officer must sanction or reject the verified application within 15 days of receipt [GO-5.2] and [WF-T6]. If rejected, the student may file an appeal to the Director, Social Welfare within 30 days [ANS-2] and [WF-T9], who must resolve the appeal within 15 days [WF-T10]. If sanctioned, the scholarship is paid through Direct Benefit Transfer using PFMS to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account within a single instalment not later than 31 March of the academic year [GO-6.1], [GO-6.2], and [WF-T12]. If a DBT payment fails, the student is notified by SMS to correct bank details within 30 days and re-initiate the payment in the next weekly batch [ANS-1] and [WF-T14] to [WF-T15]. The system then records the credit confirmation [WF-T13] or closes the application [WF-T16].

Throughout the processing lifecycle, the applicant receives SMS notifications at every stage [GO-7.2] and can raise grievances through an online facility [GO-7.1]. Grievances must be resolved within 7 working days of receipt [GO-7.3], [WF-T11], and the system provides a dashboard to the District Social Welfare Officer showing district-wise status of applications [GO-8.1] and [GO-8.2]. The service is notified under the Rajyapradesh Right to Service Act, with the scholarship sanctioned within 30 working days of submission of a complete application [GO-9] and [WF-T6]. The portal shall be available in Hindi and English [MIN-3] and must function on low-end Android phones on 3G connections [MIN-5], with personal data used strictly for scheme purposes [GO-10].
